navigation.question: What navigation methods do your mobile robots support?
navigation.answer: Our mobile robots support multiple navigation methods including laser SLAM, visual navigation, QR code navigation, etc. They can be flexibly configured according to customer site environments to meet diverse application needs.

development.question: Does the robot control system support secondary development and system integration?
development.answer: Yes. We provide open SDK and API for customers to facilitate secondary development and integration with third-party systems, helping to achieve personalized function expansion.

customization.question: Can robots or systems be customized according to customer requirements?
customization.answer: Yes. We support custom software and hardware development, including structure, functions, interfaces and other aspects. Please contact us to discuss specific requirements.

companyIntroDetailed.para1: Hangzhou ZeroAnt Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise founded by the research team from Beihang University Hangzhou Innovation Research Institute, focusing on the R&D of intelligent robot complete solutions. Currently, it provides highly reliable robot intelligent system solutions for biopharmaceutical, semiconductor and other industries.
companyIntroDetailed.para2: The company relies on the Zhejiang Provincial Key Laboratory of Industrial Big Data and Robot Intelligent Systems, independently developing the "Intelligent Robot Operating System" (AiROS), conquering core technologies such as mobile robot autonomous navigation, high-speed and high-precision control of robotic arms, 3D spatial semantic perception, and multi-robot collaborative scheduling, creating a full-stack software ecosystem and modular hardware platform.
companyIntroDetailed.para3: The team has established normalized cooperation mechanisms with multiple top domestic institutions, forming a closed-loop innovation system of "industry-university-research-application". As a pioneer of industrial intelligent infrastructure, ZeroAnt Technology is promoting industry intelligent upgrades with fully autonomous and controllable technology, continuously empowering high-quality development of the manufacturing industry.
companyIntroDetailed.financingDesc: The team is currently in the angel round financing stage. If you are interested in the team or have cooperation intentions, please contact us by email. Startup teams value time, no casual inquiries please!

medical-automation.title: Medical Automation
medical-automation.description: Provides efficient automated item transfer and intelligent scheduling for hospitals and labs using AiROS. Features 18-axis control and 0.02mm positioning accuracy for samples, drugs, and medical devices. Serves customers like Huazhi Biology and PerkinElmer, reducing costs from 300K to 140K yuan.
medical-automation.coreAdvantages: 90,000-hour continuous operation, multi-floor intelligent scheduling, reduced cross-infection risk
medical-automation.typicalApplications: Lab automation pipeline, automated pharmacy, medical supply distribution, ultrasound robots

semiconductor.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing
semiconductor.description: High-precision wafer and chip handling systems using AiROS with ≤10us real-time jitter. Over 200 wafer transfer robots shipped to major domestic manufacturers. Features 0.02mm positioning accuracy and 18-axis control for complex process flows.
semiconductor.coreAdvantages: 90,000-hour operation, 50% cost reduction, cleanroom IP54 protection
semiconductor.typicalApplications: Wafer FOUP handling, chip packaging/testing, cleanroom logistics, equipment loading

intelligent-manufacturing.title: Intelligent Manufacturing
intelligent-manufacturing.description: Multi-OS embedded systems with domestic real-time OS for high-precision automation. Features dual-robot collaboration and high-speed arms supporting 6000mm/s motion and sub-millimeter control for electronics, automotive, and 3C manufacturing.
intelligent-manufacturing.coreAdvantages: Multi-robot collaboration, ≤10us real-time jitter, complex process support, domestic replacement
intelligent-manufacturing.typicalApplications: Electronics assembly, automotive welding, precision assembly, quality inspection, flexible lines

ai-robotics.title: AI Robotics
ai-robotics.description: Based on large language models and artificial intelligence technology, developing embodied intelligent robot solutions. Through UR robot large language model action grasping technology, it enables autonomous learning and intelligent decision-making capabilities of robots. Combined with 14-axis design of dual-arm humanoid robots and AiROS operating system, it provides highly intelligent human-robot collaboration solutions, promoting robots into various industries.
ai-robotics.coreAdvantages: Large language model driven, 14-axis dual-arm design, autonomous learning capability, human-robot collaboration
ai-robotics.typicalApplications: Intelligent grasping, education and research, service robots, human-robot collaboration, embodied intelligence

industrial-control.title: Industrial Control
industrial-control.description: Based on domestic industrial real-time operating system and EtherCAT bus technology, providing autonomous and controllable high-performance industrial control solutions. Through millisecond real-time response and 18-axis simultaneous control capabilities, it enables precise synchronous control and real-time coordinated motion of multi-axis motors. Supporting real-time jitter ≤10us, it meets stringent requirements of industrial automation and achieves domestic substitution of key technologies.
industrial-control.coreAdvantages: Millisecond real-time response, 18-axis simultaneous control, autonomous and controllable, domestic substitution
industrial-control.typicalApplications: Multi-axis motion control, servo motor stations, industrial automation, precision machining, real-time control systems

offline-programming.title: Offline Programming
offline-programming.description: Based on multi-OS hybrid deployment embedded virtual machine technology, providing advanced offline programming and virtual simulation solutions. Through digital twin technology and virtual debugging environment, it enables efficient development and optimization of robot programs without requiring on-site physical objects. Supporting unified management of heterogeneous systems, it significantly improves programming efficiency and operational safety, reducing on-site debugging time and costs.
offline-programming.coreAdvantages: Virtual simulation environment, digital twin technology, offline debugging, unified management of heterogeneous systems
offline-programming.typicalApplications: Robot offline programming, process path simulation, virtual debugging verification, complex trajectory planning, system integration testing

intelligent-navigation.title: Intelligent Navigation
intelligent-navigation.description: Based on 360-degree LiDAR scanning and laser SLAM technology, providing advanced robot intelligent navigation and environmental perception solutions. Through comprehensive environmental perception and millimeter-level precise positioning technology, combined with mobile robot scheduling systems, it provides reliable autonomous navigation capabilities for AGVs and mobile robots. It enables intelligent path planning, dynamic obstacle avoidance, and multi-machine collaborative operations in complex environments, supporting 500kg load capacity.
intelligent-navigation.coreAdvantages: 360-degree LiDAR scanning, laser SLAM positioning, intelligent path planning, multi-machine collaborative navigation
intelligent-navigation.typicalApplications: AGV intelligent navigation, dynamic environment mapping, real-time obstacle avoidance, optimal path planning, multi-robot scheduling

surface-treatment.title: Surface Treatment
surface-treatment.description: Based on six-axis and four-axis robotic arm technology, providing high-precision, high-reliability industrial robot solutions. Through advanced force control technology and path planning algorithms, it enables grinding, polishing, welding, assembly and other industrial applications. Supporting 0.02mm repeat positioning accuracy and continuous 90,000-hour fault-free operation, providing stable and reliable automation equipment for manufacturing.
surface-treatment.coreAdvantages: High-precision positioning, force control technology, multi-axis coordination, long-term stable operation
surface-treatment.typicalApplications: Metal parts grinding, precision assembly, welding operations, surface treatment, deburring

smart-logistics.title: Smart Logistics
smart-logistics.description: Based on mobile robot scheduling systems and AGV automatic guidance technology, providing intelligent logistics solutions for unified scheduling of multi-brand, multi-type robots. Through advanced technologies such as 360-degree radar scanning and laser SLAM navigation, it enables autonomous navigation and precise positioning in complex environments. Supporting 500kg load capacity and multi-machine collaborative operations, significantly improving factory logistics efficiency and warehouse automation levels.
smart-logistics.coreAdvantages: Multi-machine unified scheduling, intelligent path planning, large load capacity, multi-scenario adaptation
smart-logistics.typicalApplications: Factory internal logistics, warehouse handling, distribution centers, multi-machine collaborative operations, intelligent scheduling

pharmaceutical-automation.title: Pharmaceutical Automation
pharmaceutical-automation.description: Focusing on automation needs in the biopharmaceutical industry, based on AiROS robot operating system and high-precision control technology, providing intelligent solutions for biological laboratories and pharmaceutical companies. Through personalized prescription pharmaceutical technology and laboratory automation equipment, it enables full-process automation of drug research, production, and testing, serving well-known customers such as Huazhi Biology and PerkinElmer.
pharmaceutical-automation.coreAdvantages: High-precision control, clean environment adaptation, GMP standards, domestic substitution
pharmaceutical-automation.typicalApplications: Laboratory automation, personalized prescription drugs, drug preparation, biological sample processing, quality testing

precision-assembly.title: Precision Assembly
precision-assembly.description: Based on four-axis and six-axis robotic arm technology, providing high-precision assembly solutions with 0.02mm repeat positioning accuracy. Through advanced motion control algorithms and vision-guided technology, supporting 6000mm/s high-speed motion to achieve precise assembly of complex products. Widely applied in 3C electronics, optical devices, precision instruments and other high-end manufacturing fields, helping customers achieve high-quality, high-efficiency automated production.
precision-assembly.coreAdvantages: 0.02mm repeat positioning accuracy, 6000mm/s high-speed motion, multi-axis coordinated control, vision guidance
precision-assembly.typicalApplications: 3C electronics assembly, optical device assembly, precision instrument manufacturing, high-speed high-precision operations, flexible assembly lines

composite-systems.title: Composite Systems
composite-systems.description: Based on composite robot technology and multi-OS hybrid deployment virtual machines, integrating multiple functional modules to provide comprehensive automation solutions. Through multi-functional integration, intelligent scheduling, and unified management of heterogeneous systems, it enables efficient collaboration and flexible production in complex scenarios. Supporting composite configurations of mobile platforms + robotic arms, it meets diverse industrial application needs and improves overall system efficiency.
composite-systems.coreAdvantages: Multi-functional integration, intelligent scheduling, flexible production, unified management of heterogeneous systems
composite-systems.typicalApplications: Composite robot applications, intelligent manufacturing, automated logistics, multi-task collaboration, flexible production lines
